name: patient_has_finding_of_gout_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has a history of gout.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has a documented history of gout.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not have a documented history of gout.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has a history of gout.
